listing.name: Vexlia's Random Flag Assortment
listing.summary: Long cooking flag pack containing a lot of old and new, fun and unconnected ideas which don't fit any one theme besides being cool. Created over time as a personal challenge, for my own use or while exploring other concepts they all come together into this new flag pack.

aiDescription: Adds a diverse collection of flags and crests with varied designs and themes. Includes a mix of old and new concepts that don't follow a single unifying theme. The pack is intended to be fun and visually interesting, with no specific narrative or faction focus.
